business-duration-faster.title: Specifying the number of years a business has operated predicts faster funding regardless of gender.
business-duration-faster.body: Pitches that include the specific duration of business operation or professional experience tend to accelerate funding for both men and women.

female-savings-goal-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention the goal of building savings fund faster.
female-savings-goal-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly state the intention to build up savings are associated with increased funding speed.

verbosity-slower-general.title: Higher verbosity and excessive personal detail predict slower funding regardless of gender.
verbosity-slower-general.body: Pitches that are significantly longer or contain excessive personal narrative tend to fund more slowly for both men and women.

monthly-income-slower-general.title: Pitches that include specific monthly income figures predict slower funding regardless of gender.
monthly-income-slower-general.body: The inclusion of precise monthly income amounts is associated with slower funding speeds for both male and female borrowers.

female-business-success-faster.title: Female borrowers who emphasize that their business is currently doing well or is being sustained fund faster.
female-business-success-faster.body: Pitches from women that highlight current business success or the ability to sustain operations through previous support accelerate funding.

female-family-future-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention securing the future of their family fund faster.
female-family-future-faster.body: Pitches from women that emphasize the long-term security and future of their family are associated with increased funding speed.

female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention sustaining business through past NWTF loans fund faster.
female-nwtf-resurgence-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly mention using previous loans from NWTF to sustain their business activities accelerate funding.

female-repayment-history-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their own previous loan repayment history fund faster.
female-repayment-history-faster.body: Pitches from women that explicitly reference a successful history of repaying previous loans are associated with increased funding speed.

female-widow-status-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention being a widow may fund more slowly.

female-dedicated-farmer-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'dedicated smallholder farmers' may fund faster.

female-inventory-list-faster.body: Female borrowers who list specific inventory items like canned goods may fund faster.

female-expansion-goal-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention a goal to expand the business may fund faster.

female-counts-children-animals-faster.body: Female borrowers who include specific counts of children or animals may fund faster.

female-children-college-slower.body: Female borrowers who mention sending children to college may fund more slowly.

female-home-ownership-faster.body: Female borrowers who mention owning their own home may fund faster.

female-hardworking-faster.body: Female borrowers who describe themselves as 'hardworking' may fund faster.

female-personal-hardship-slower.body: Female borrowers who describe personal hardships, such as displacement, may fund more slowly.

female-equipment-list-slower.body: Female borrowers who provide a detailed list of equipment to be purchased may fund more slowly.

technical-specificity-faster.title: Pitches that detail specific business inputs, professional skills, concrete objectives, or economic and environmental rationales accelerate funding regardless of gender.
technical-specificity-faster.retrospective: Retired due to lowest confidence to make room for promoted repayment history claim.

female-equipment-detail-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide detailed lists of specific equipment or high-quality inputs may fund more slowly.
female-equipment-detail-slower.retrospective: Retired to make room for new observations regarding inventory and expansion goals.

female-family-details-slower.title: Female borrowers who provide specific counts or ages of children may fund more slowly.
female-family-details-slower.retrospective: Contradicted by observation that specific counts of children/animals accelerate funding.

female-geography-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention specific geographic locations like towns or cities may fund more slowly.
female-geography-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-idr-amount-slower.title: Female borrowers who include a specific loan amount in Indonesian rupiahs (IDR) may fund more slowly.
female-idr-amount-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observations.

female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.title: Female borrowers who use the phrase 'hardworking entrepreneur' may fund more slowly.
female-hardworking-entrepreneur-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new observation regarding college funding.

female-specific-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who include their specific age may fund faster.
female-specific-age-faster.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for married status observation.

female-married-status-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention being married may fund faster.
female-married-status-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for recurring observation about borrower age.

female-age-faster.title: Female borrowers who mention their specific age may fund faster.
female-age-faster.retrospective: Dropped to make room for female-home-ownership-faster.

female-business-challenge-slower.title: Female borrowers who mention a specific business challenge may fund more slowly.
female-business-challenge-slower.retrospective: Dropped as stale puzzle to make room for new equipment list observation.
